name: component_agent_designer
description: Reusable Agent-factory SubDAG. A normal Model authors an inspectable Agent Spec, approval gates the mutation, then a bounded Agent searches the catalog and materializes the Identity and visual Harness.

component.name: agent_designer
component.description: Turn a role request into an approved Agent Spec and runnable Agent without asking the model to hand-write DAG JSON.

request.description: Desired role, environment, constraints and success criteria

architect.description: Identity that designs and materializes the Agent

design.description: Editable Agent-Spec policy; no archetype keywords are hidden in runtime code

approve.prompt_text:
创建下面这个 Identity + Harness 吗？你可以先检查模型生成的 Agent Spec。
${ctx.agent_spec}

materialize.instructions:
Materialize this approved Agent Spec: ${ctx.agent_spec}
First search_capabilities for each proposed Skill or equivalent complete Agent. Reuse existing exact folder names and remove invented or redundant Skills from the spec. If an equivalent complete Identity/Harness already exists, report it instead of duplicating it. Otherwise call create_agent_system once, passing both a concise description and the corrected structured spec. Finish with the created Identity, Harness and acceptance test.

invalid.value: Agent Spec JSON was invalid; no files were changed.
